page.title: Profile & settings
page.description: Manage your account and make your wardrobe work for you.
page.analysisNote: AI analysis uses saved photo rotations. Whether results are saved depends on the AI automation setting below. Otherwise, suggestions will need your approval. Background removal is not repeated.
page.noWardrobes: You do not have a wardrobe yet.
page.queueResult: {{name}}: queued {{queued}}, already queued or processing {{pending}}, without a photo {{missing}}.
page.deleteWardrobeDescription: Deleting “{{name}}” also deletes all garments in this wardrobe, their photos, outfits and history. This includes garments belonging to other members of a family wardrobe. This action cannot be undone. Your account will remain.
page.allowOverwrite: Allow AI to overwrite garment metadata
page.allowOverwriteDescription: Automatically save predicted attributes after AI analysis without asking you to approve each garment.
page.allowOverwriteNote: This also applies to reanalysis and manually corrected attributes. Manual names and notes are preserved. Enabling this option does not start an analysis.
page.name: Name
page.passwordDescription: You can set a new password for your account.
page.privacyTitle: Privacy is part of your style.
page.privacyDescription: Your data and photos are stored on the server hosting this installation. The app does not require a cloud account.
page.installDescription: On your phone, choose “Add to Home Screen” from the browser menu. Installation requires HTTPS. Offline, only the app shell is shown; private data is not stored for offline use.
